children.game_version: Follow-the-leader circle game using shuffle steps

seniors.seated_version: Perform shuffle rhythm with feet while seated
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a partner or support for balance, reduce tempo
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo, limited range of motion

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Leader's right hand on follower's back or shoulder; left hand holds follower's right hand at shoulder height
movement_profile.footwork: Shuffle steps followed by walking steps
movement_profile.partnering: Leader determines patterns; follower responds to leads
movement_profile.posture: Upright, partners facing each other in closed position

signature_moves.description: Follower is led through a quarter semicircle clockwise then counterclockwise
signature_moves.name: Arching semicircle

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Shuffle steps (1 and 2, 3 and 4) followed by walking steps (5, 6)
music_profile.sound_description: The music is standard country music in common time, providing a steady beat for the shuffle and walking steps.

teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the shuffle rhythm before adding the walking steps.
